verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 as DROPPED (ADR-1677). append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 AS DROPPED (ADR-1677). OWNER RULING 2026-09-30: "DROP the feature; do not build it." Instead, remove every member-facing and marketing mention that promises Doomscroll mode, and leave historical ADR text alone. The checker accepts only open | done | parked | blocked; parked means later, which the ruling rules out, so the row is done and this paragraph records that nothing was built. PREMISE RE-TESTED at f7f7d3075 (main): no code, setting or member copy offers the mode. Every doomscroll hit under app, components, lib and content/help is about quitting the habit (the /loneliness section and FAQ, its page-editor spec, the /llms.txt entry, the help guide How to stop doomscrolling) and promises no feature, so all of it stays. The promise lived in three files read as current, and each is fixed: docs/ENGAGEMENT-MARKETING-ENGINE.md (the paragraph that presented it as the plan now says ADR-155 proposed the toggle and the owner dropped it, pointing at ADR-1677), design_handoff/BRIEF-04-MARKETING-AND-FUNNELS.md (the Not a content casino angle, whose pitch was the toggle, is deleted; Anti-feed and Screen-time inversion carry the stance), and the DAWN mockup design_handoff/dawn/ui_kits/screens/settings.html (the switch row is deleted; the Quiet beat keeps Weekly digest and Quiet hours). The next outbound DAWN handoff should name that mockup change so a re-export does not restore it. ADR-155 in DECISIONS.md, the superseded BACKLOG.md section F item and the frozen 2026-08-17 census are history and unchanged. No migration, no code.
